One Spirit Complimentary Therapies offers 4 different modalities which can be used on their own or if combined, compliment each other . WEBB 4 Pets (Whole Energy Body Balance) which is the brain child of Australian Vetinarian Dr Edward Bassingthwaight, Small Animal and Canine Acupressure, Tui Na (ancient traditional Chinese Massage ) and Photobiomodulation therapy. 

Visit my website:-  www.os-animaltherapies.co.uk  for further information, or find me on facebook:- @OneSpiritAcupressure  or Twitter @OAcupressure. Please get in touch if you have any concerns or queries, Office: 01276 300207 email: sib@os-animaltherapies
